title: marketdata.fetch.requested (v1)
description: A market-data download/fetch task. Published by market-data itself (its own outbox, after `POST /internal/v1/data/fetches`) to `lean.jobs` with routing key `marketdata.fetch.v1`, AMQP type `jobs.v1.MarketDataFetchRequested`; consumed by market-data task runners (one task per process). Results are atomically published into `lean-data` (staging + rename, ADR 0004). Events use kind `marketdata`.

submittedBy.description: User id, or the job id of a fetch-on-miss backtest.
